name: Palak Paneer
description: Cottage cheese cubes simmered in a mildly spiced spinach purée.
steps: Blanch spinach leaves in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then transfer immediately to ice-cold water to retain green colour.
Blend blanched spinach with green chillies into a smooth puree.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, chopped onions, and ginger-garlic paste; saute until golden.
Add tomato puree and ground spices; cook until oil separates.
Pour in the spinach puree and simmer for 4-5 minutes on low flame.
Gently add paneer cubes, cook for another 2 minutes, and serve hot with phulka or rice.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi
description: Nutritious and comforting one-pot meal of rice, split yellow moong dal, and cumin tadka.
steps: Wash rice and moong dal together; soak for 15 minutes.
Pressure cook with water, turmeric, and salt for 4 whistles until very soft.
In a small pan, heat ghee, add cumin seeds, crushed black pepper, and asafoetida.
Pour hot tadka over the cooked khichdi, mix thoroughly and serve with curd.

name: Steamed Idli with Mixed Vegetable Sambar
description: Traditional South Indian breakfast of fluffy steamed fermented rice cakes served with aromatic lentil vegetable stew.
steps: Grease idli plates with drops of oil, pour batter, and steam for 10-12 minutes.
Boil vegetables in tamarind water with sambar powder and turmeric.
Add cooked mashed toor dal, simmer for 5 minutes, and finish with mustard and curry leaf tempering.
Serve warm idlis dipped in fresh sambar.
